review_method: Manual visual review of all 15 existing 20-image Open Images v10 training contact sheets, with full-size checks for ambiguous examples. Quarantine entire images only when the target object or scene is clearly outside the project label policy. This is not complete instance-level relabeling.

excluded.a23ef7417f7bb943: bicycle target is a handlebar-only close-up
excluded.7879eb9a4baec86d: motorcycle target is an engine-only close-up
excluded.be276a4e24080c9f: motorcycle target is a small scale-model toy
excluded.b23113420f5e03bb: motorcycle target is a fuel-tank and engine close-up
excluded.d32706f1c4816131: powered four-wheel ATV outside motorcycle policy
excluded.1d0f488608d16b06: motorcycle shown inside a video game screenshot

limitations: Crowd scenes may have incomplete source boxes. Their instance labels need a separate manual review; no automatic pseudo-labels were added.
